categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Group your country's layers in categories. Each one decides what counts as a finding, its threshold and how results look. Monbo's users see them when choosing layers, in the results, in the report and in the methodology.
categories.unreadable: Your country's categories file can't be read, so you can't create or edit categories. Ask operations to fix it:
categories.rejected: Some categories in the file have errors and aren't shown. Their layers stay hidden until operations fixes the file:

polarity.avoid: Marks what must be avoided: overlapping the layer is a finding.
polarity.required: Marks what is allowed: falling outside the layer is a finding.

locks.enabled: It has published layers ({{layers}}). Hide them to enable or disable the category.
locks.polarity: It can't change while layers are published ({{layers}}): their results would read the other way round. Hide them first.
locks.temporal: It can't change because the category has layers ({{layers}}): their years would stop fitting.
locks.unreadable: The categories file can't be read.

categories.toggleError: The category's state couldn't be changed.

form.name: Name
form.descriptionHelp: Shown in the analysis, the report and the methodology.
form.idHelp: Permanent: it identifies the category in the layers and can't be changed or reused.
form.polarity: What do this category's layers mark?

avoid.title: What must be avoided
avoid.help: For example, forest loss or protected areas. A polygon that overlaps the layer has a finding.

required.title: What is allowed
required.help: For example, the agricultural frontier. A polygon that falls outside the layer has a finding.

form.temporalHelp: Turn it on if each layer has a baseline and a comparison year, like forest loss. Leave it off for layers without a period, like protected areas or the agricultural frontier.
form.thresholdHelp: A polygon has findings when its finding is above the threshold.
form.publishedNote: This category has published layers: changing the threshold or the texts changes how their results read from now on.

preview.nothingFlagged: With a 100% threshold no polygon has findings.

values.name: Deforestation by forest cover change of Colombia
values.source: Institute of Hydrology, Meteorology and Environmental Studies (IDEAM) of Colombia
values.publishDate: June-July of the following year, approximately
values.considerations:
### IDEAM forest definition

- Tree cover of at least 30% and a minimum height of 5 meters.
- Minimum area of 1 hectare.

**It does not distinguish** between primary and secondary forest.

raster.intro: A single-band GeoTIFF with values 0 (outside the layer) and 1 (inside the layer). We check every pixel and convert it to an optimized GeoTIFF. The layer keeps its current raster until the new one is validated.

publish.title: Publish the layer
publish.hint: So it shows up in the analysis

drop.title: Drop your raster here
drop.rejected: That file can't be used: upload a single .tif or .tiff file.

raster.nodataHelp: Only if the file doesn't declare one.
raster.slow: This can take a few minutes. Don't close this page.
raster.failed: This raster could not be used.

validated.title: Raster validated and active
validated.text: {{filename}} · every pixel has the value 0 or 1.

raster.publishNotice: Not published yet. Until then, the layer doesn't appear in the territorial analysis.
raster.publishError: The layer could not be published.

uploadErrors.tooLarge: The file is larger than the server accepts.
uploadErrors.busy: Another raster is being processed. Try again in a few minutes.
uploadErrors.generic: The raster could not be uploaded.
uploadErrors.statusUnavailable: The status of this upload is no longer available. Reload the layer to see whether its raster changed.

issues.not_geotiff: The file is not a readable GeoTIFF.
issues.band_count: The raster must have exactly one band (it has {{bands}}).
issues.not_integer: The raster must have integer values (it has {{dtype}}). Use 0 outside the layer and 1 inside it.
issues.no_crs: The raster must have a coordinate reference system.
issues.nodata_is_positive: Nodata cannot be 1, because 1 marks the pixels inside the layer. Use a different nodata value.
issues.resolution_unavailable: The raster's pixel size could not be determined from its reference system and grid.
issues.resolution_mismatch: The layer pixel size ({{declared}} m) differs from the raster ({{measured}} m). Update the layer pixel size or choose another raster.
issues.resolution_varies: The raster's pixel size varies from {{min}} m to {{max}} m across its latitudes, too much for a single layer pixel size. Reproject it to an equal-area reference system or split it.
issues.not_binary: The raster must be binary (0 = outside the layer, 1 = inside the layer). Other values found: {{values}}. If one of them marks nodata, upload it again with that value.
issues.loss_years: The raster has values that look like years ({{values}}). Binarize it against its baseline year before uploading.
issues.conversion_mismatch: The conversion didn't keep every pixel, so nothing was changed.
issues.interrupted: The process was interrupted because the server restarted. Upload the file again.
issues.unexpected: An unexpected error happened while processing the raster.
issues.nodata_ignored: The file already declares nodata {{declared}}; the value {{requested}} was ignored.
issues.no_positive_pixels: The raster has no pixels inside the layer (value 1).
